facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Nigeria: IXPN in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt, and AMS-IX Lagos and AF-CIX, Lagos.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places Nigeria's exchange points in more than one city: Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.
